---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in a Sinon plugin or repository tool.
---

# Bug Report

## Problem

Describe the affected plugin or tool and the observed behavior.

## Reproduction And Evidence

Provide minimal steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
Include relevant host and tool versions without credentials or private environment details.

## Acceptance Criteria

Describe the behavior that would resolve this problem.

## Scope And Related Work

Identify affected components and link related issues or pull requests.

## Verification And Limitations

Record commands and results, including failed or unrun checks.
